about_the_game:
microFISHER is a cozy and relaxing fishing game where your ultimate goal is to collect every fish specimen. To achieve this, you must explore and discover various lakes, each home to a unique fish that your team is aiming for. The fishing system is simple yet engaging, featuring a timing-based mechanic. A bar spins around a circle, and you must carefully time your catch by hitting the bar when it turns blue. While easy to learn, this mechanic can become a fun and rewarding challenge as you chase after bigger fish.

           

          To become the best fisherman, you will need to venture across different islands in search of essential upgrades. The toolbox upgrade allows you to cast your fishing line farther, giving you access to bigger and much-wanted fish. Meanwhile, finding bucket upgrades increases the number of fish that you can carry, allowing for longer and more productive fishing sessions.

           

          Your personal fishing camp serves as a home, where you can store and manage your fishing gear. Here, you’ll find all your fishing rods and a cozy tent where you can track your progress and view the fish you've caught. Along the way, you might discover a wooden tub. This is a valuable upgrade for your base. It acts as a fish storage place, allowing you to empty your buckets, making your fishing trips more efficient.

           

          Whether you're a seasoned angler or just looking for a peaceful adventure, microFISHER invites you to relax and explore. Cast your line, upgrade your gear, and become the ultimate fishing master!

short_description: Put on your overalls and grab your fishing rod, those fishes are waiting for you! Explore the island while catching as many as you can. Get ready to document over a thousand specimens in your book and prepare for a long journey. Meanwhile, search for upgrades to improve your fishing technique.
